launch_dependency: Complete and archive the unchanged SW0133 three-arm pilot first
hypothesis: Assignments learned directly from the full actual spike history can separate objects without depending on current QCC group seeds and count
source: Immutable same-seed SW0097 core and registered encoder/statistics; frozen SW0130 integration equations

input.actual: Raw emitted component spikes [B,4,256,512] from settled half of native1024 rollout
input.gate_control: Native scalar gate [B,N,T] folded exactly as source via repeat_interleave(4), stored[B,4,256,512]; shared identical component rows are intentional

binder.mechanism: Explicit Slot Attention-style competitive binding; no novelty claim for slot algorithm
binder.input_projection: Flatten component/time per patch:2048->64, then LayerNorm
binder.initialization: Fixed iid noise seed134 [1,11,64], shared learned mu/log_scale [1,1,64]; same head initialization across arms
binder.updates: Shared key/query/value; softmax over slots; per-slot patch-normalized value update; shared GRU and residual64->128->64 MLP
binder.final_P: Recompute assignment from slots after third refinement
binder.occupancy: Unused slots allowed; no equal-occupancy loss or GT count

decoder.inputs: Slot64 latent and live P-derived relative pixel XY; SW0132 centroid/variance with exact intra-cell variance
decoder.mixture: Patch P expanded to8x8 pixels is the sole RGB mask mixture; no independent alpha head
decoder.loss: Full128x128x3 RGB MSE per image, batch mean

arms.gate_joint: Native gates only into binder; same trainable backbone; original actual-Q objective remains
arms.actual_frozen: Actual spikes; entire source encoder/core/integration frozen; only binder/decoder train

warmup.actual_arms: Share warmed head/decoder weights and Adam32 moments within seed
warmup.gate_arm: Identical initial weights and equal images/updates; separate warm artifact appropriate to gate input

temporal_credit.boundary: Detach recurrent states and delayed phase history; static gamma/coupling prepared live once and reused in tail
temporal_credit.limitation: Truncated BPTT, not full1024 backward; full512 head input retained

objective.lambda: Fresh source0 after new actual-spike warm32:0.25*median(old/R joint-gradient norm) over first4 TRAIN batches; excludes head/decoder; frozen for arms/seeds
objective.old_loss_coefficients: Unchanged source recipe, including0.867 density target

pilot.gradient_clipping: Unique joint union1; head/decoder union1 separately
pilot.optimizer: Fresh joint Adam; exact appropriate warm head/decoder Adam32
pilot.pass_order: Pass0 exact source order; pass_index1..15 permutation from NumPy RandomState(134000+seed*100+pass_index); record each actualID order SHA
pilot.endpoint: Final4096 only; no intermediate validation masks, checkpoint selection or scientific early stop

evaluation.primary: Argmax learned P masks; largest hard slot background, ties first occupied patch then slot index; canonical foreground IDs by first occupied patch
evaluation.secondary: Original actual-spike QCC .50/minFG2/largest-component background on same backbone; cannot replace failed primary
evaluation.ground_truth: Unchanged modal8x8 pixel vote on native128 instance masks, min-ID tie
evaluation.expansion: Primary actual_joint FG strictly above source97,gate_joint,actual_frozen AND positive paired95% lower bounds for all three comparisons
evaluation.failed_recipe: Close this fixed16-pass budget recipe without slot/temperature/decoder/LR sweeps; failure does not disprove binder architecture at all training budgets

release_checks: Exact native zero-init full1024 trace/Q parity on actual source
Finite real optimizer updates and all declared trained families
Shared actual-arm warm state; equally budgeted separate gate warm state
Gate-head R has no dendritic/membrane/integration downstream credit
Record P occupancy, event activity and RGB slot-scramble diagnostics without positivity eligibility rule
scientific_limits: Pilot alone proves neither every gate necessary nor data scaling. Follow with matched retrained stage controls and separate fresh-initialization scaling curves; final70k three-seed comparable Slot comparison remains required.
